summary.en-US: Keyboard-driven fuzzy finder that adds and opens bookmarks of the tempesta bookmark store.

description.en-US:
Browser integration for tempesta, the bookmark manager CLI inspired by pass. Two keyboard shortcuts open a minimal rofi-like finder over the current page: one adds the page to the bookmark store, the other opens a saved bookmark in a new tab.

Bookmarks are plain TOML files in ~/.bookmark-store, optionally versioned with git, shared with the tempesta command line.

Requires the tempesta CLI with its native messaging host registered (tempesta native-host install). Source code and documentation: https://github.com/x71c9/tempesta-browser-extension

version.approval_notes: The code is bundled, not minified, with esbuild. To rebuild from the attached source archive: Node.js 24, npm 11, then `npm ci && node build.mjs --release`; the add-on is generated in dist/firefox. The add-on talks to the tempesta CLI (https://github.com/x71c9/tempesta) through native messaging and sends no data anywhere else.
